Is this belief kufar? Please answer with refernces from early scholars. Question: Assalam O Alaikum, Whatis the ruling about person/sect, who believe that their Imams are higher/superios in status than some/many of the Prophets? Is this belief kufar? Please answer with refernces from early scholars. JazakAllah Answer ID: 3171 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 235/225=J) Any person believing imams as superior than prophets is having a belief of kufr (infidelity). For details see: Shia Sunni Ikhtelaaf by Mufti Yusuf Ludhianwi. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
